thread:
Sam: Heads-up, filing a docs PR to add a concise migration checklist for swapping models and handling v1->v2 SDK differences. Draft here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/601

Rina: Nice. Can we include a short FAQ about 'why my prompts behave differently after model swap'? I usually point to different tokenization, context window, and quantization. A quick bulleted explanation helps support teams.

Jorge: Also add troubleshooting steps: 1) compare top-1 completions, 2) run the prompt through the eval harness, 3) enable sampling parity flags. We should include a CLI snippet for the eval harness invocation.

Sam: Good ideas. Drafting a little block: 
```
# run eval harness locally
ri-eval run --config=examples/migration/eval-config.yaml --snapshot=baseline
```

Jorge: Small note: the old /v1/models endpoint response had `choices` whereas v2 responses embed blocks in `output`. Let's give an explicit transformation example in the migration guide so engineers know how to map fields.

Linh: I'll add that mapping example. Also we should remind folks to rotate API keys used in CI when migrating to new SDK pinned versions (I've seen flakes when locked env vars expect deprecated client behavior).

docs-bot: Link-checker: broken link found in docs/guides/migrations.md -> anchor `#response-fields` not found.

Sam: Oops, thanks bot. I'll fix the anchor and also expand the "field mapping" section with a table and code snippets for Python and curl. Keep it compact.

Rina: For deprecation comms, propose a short blurb: "v1 API will be deprecated on 2026-07-01. After this date v1 endpoints may return 410. Migrate to v2 SDKs and model endpoints; see migration guide." Add an FAQ around timelines.

Sam: Sounds right. Add a note about transitional redirects we plan to keep until 2026-06-15. Kai from infra confirmed we'll maintain server-side redirects for 2 weeks after the soft-sunset.

Jorge: Can someone sanity-check the streaming example for v2? I pasted this: 
```
with client.responses.stream(model="redwood-stream", input="tokenize this") as s:
  for ev in s:
    if ev.type == "delta":
      print(ev.delta, end="")
```

Linh: Works, but add an example showing how to handle finalization events `event.type == \"response.completed\"` so users can access metadata like `duration_ms`.

Sam: I'll add that. Planning to land this morning once the link-fix and eval CLI snippet are in. Tagging docs-bot for preview build.

docs-bot: PR #601 preview build queued.

Rina: Also please add the SDK changelog callout for the v2 release notes and put the migrator script link (tools/migrate-v1-to-v2.sh) so customers can try an automated transform.

Sam: Good — adding the `migrate-v1-to-v2.sh` reference and a short usage example.

docs-bot: PR #601 preview build passed  checks green.

Sam: Merged. Thanks everyone.
